summary: Mission Mountain, Idaho: 1920 crow's nest and 1930s tower; tower gone, but the nest's boards, wire and nails remain in a tree on the summit inside McCroskey State Park.

facts.status_note: The 1930s tower is gone; boards, wire and nails of the 1920s crow's nest remain in a tree on the summit (2024 and 2025 reports)

access.note: Inside McCroskey State Park; a gravel road reaches the summit, which any car can access. The park road is closed in winter.

visit.trail_note: Gravel road to the summit picnic area; the nest is in a tree and we do not suggest climbing it

corrections.why: The 1930s tower is gone, but boards, wire and nails of the crow's nest remain in the tree (WillhiteWeb, 2024; Idaho Fire Lookouts, 2025). 'Ruins' is the status for remains only. Editor may prefer to keep 'gone' with this status note.
The FFLA list gives Mission Mountain exactly Mineral Mountain's coordinates, which looks like a copy error. Keep the firelookout.com point the record already uses.
The summit lies inside McCroskey State Park, a state park (WillhiteWeb; Wikipedia).

notes_for_editor: Proposed, not applied: status gone to ruins (editor may keep gone); location fix; ownership federal to state. Location: FFLA duplicates Mineral Mountain's coordinates. The idaho_fl import record for Mission reads 'standing', which the page does not support ('Drive-Up Abandoned'). Staffing: Idaho Fire Lookouts says it has no documented staffing history; left out. Tower's existence is hedged by WillhiteWeb ('may have'); the other sources state it. Other Mission-named records exist (us-id-mission-mtn.json, us-id-harvey-mission.json); not checked for overlap. Verified 2026-10-10: the 2024 boards-and-wire sentence is dated to the 2024 report; the 2025 post sentence is now cited and attributes the trip to the post's writers rather than a team.
